gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: The ministry tried to play ___ the incident.
gaps.explanation: play down = make something seem less important (opposite: play up).

gaps.sentence: Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
